summary: Rainmaker Worldwide filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting that effective September 10, 2026, it mutually terminated the Interim CEO Services Agreement with Larchwood Management Partners Inc., under which Michael O'Connor served as Interim CEO. O'Connor resigned as director, Chairman, Interim CEO and principal executive officer immediately after Ryan D. Moore and Michael A. Skinner were appointed to the board. Final accrued amounts total US$10,833.33 in fees plus C$139.41 expenses, bearing 10% annual interest from September 11, 2026, with a limited mutual release upon payment. No termination penalty applies. Watch for delayed filings and governance instability.
